central-america-caribbean.title: Amérika Sentral i Karibe
central-america-caribbean.description: Amérika Sentral i Karibe — Yucatán, Belize, Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Panama, Cuba, Jamaica, Hispaniola, Islanan Cayman, Puerto Rico, Antia Menor i e parti zùit di Bahamas.

south-central-us.title: Sentro-zùit di Estadonan Uni
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi i Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson i Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samoa i Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samoa, Samoa Merikano, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau, i Wallis i Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi i Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila i e islanan di Tonga.

mariana-islands.title: Guam i Islanan Mariana di Nort
mariana-islands.description: Guam i Islanan Mariana di Nort — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian i Rota.

greenland.title: Groenlandia
greenland.description: Groenlandia — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq i Tasiilaq; e kapa di glas, e Fiordo di Glas di Ilulissat i e fiordonan di zùit.

bermuda.title: Bermuda
bermuda.description: Bermuda — Hamilton, St. George’s i e Royal Naval Dockyard, e parokianan di e isla i su playanan di santu kòrá.

belarus.title: Belarus
belarus.description: Belarus — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno i Brest; e mondi di Belovezhskaya Pushcha i e pantanonan di Polesia.

channel-islands.title: Islanan di Kanal
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark i Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port i Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Islanan Faroe
faroe-islands.description: Islanan Faroe — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík i e diesocho islanan, nan pueblonan, túnelnan i kantilnan na laman.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard i Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg i Ny-Ålesund; e glasiarnan i fiordonan di Spitsbergen.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo i Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria i e Tres Siudatnan.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagaskar i e Islanan di Oséano Indio
madagascar-islands.description: Madagaskar, Komoro, Mayotte, Réunion, Mauritius i Seychelles — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis i Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudan
sudan.description: Sudan — Khartoum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid i Nyala; kaminda Nilo Blou i Nilo Blanku ta topa i e piramidenan di Meroë.

cabo-verde.title: Cabo Verde
cabo-verde.description: Cabo Verde — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria i e dies islanan, for di Santo Antão te Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: São Tomé i Príncipe
sao-tome-principe.description: São Tomé i Príncipe — São Tomé, Santo António i e mondinan tropikal i playanan di e dos islanan.

saint-helena.title: Santa Helena, Ascension i Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Santa Helena, Isla Ascension i Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown i Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangladesh
bangladesh.description: Bangladesh — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet i Cox’s Bazar; e Sundarbans i e delta di Ganges i Brahmaputra.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka i Maldivas
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka i Maldivas — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura i Malé; e region di seru, Sigiriya i e atolnan.

vietnam.title: Vietnam
vietnam.description: Vietnam — Hanoi, Siudat Ho Chi Minh, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An i Can Tho; Baia di Ha Long i e Delta di Mekong.

philippines.title: Filipinas
philippines.description: Filipinas — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio i Zamboanga; Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao i Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indonesia i Timor-Leste
indonesia.description: Indonesia i Timor-Leste — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar i Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi i Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malasia, Singapur i Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malasia, Singapur i Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapur, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching i Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine i Lago Inle; e vaye di Irrawaddy i e serunan di Shan.

cambodia-laos.title: Kambodja i Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Kambodja i Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap i Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang i Pakse; e Mekong i e Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Colombia
colombia.description: Colombia — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena i Bucaramanga; e Andes, e kosta di Karibe i e Amazonas.

venezuela.title: Venezuela
venezuela.description: Venezuela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida i Ciudad Bolívar; Salto Angel, e Orinoco i Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Perú
peru.description: Perú — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos i Puno; Machu Picchu, Lago Titicaca i e Vaye Sagrado.

ecuador.title: Ecuador
ecuador.description: Ecuador — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta i Baños; e Avenida di Volkannan, e Amazonas i Islanan Galápagos.

bolivia.title: Bolivia
bolivia.description: Bolivia — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre i Potosí; Lago Titicaca i e Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Chile
chile.description: Chile — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena i Punta Arenas; e Atacama, e Region di Lago, Patagonia i Isla di Pasku.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paraguay i Uruguay
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paraguay i Uruguay — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este i Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: E Guyananan
guianas.description: Guyana, Surinam i Guyana Franses — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne i Kourou; Kaieteur Falls i e mondi tropikal di e Skudo di Guyana.

falklands.title: Islanan Falkland
falklands.description: Islanan Falkland — Stanley, Goose Green i e islanan East Falkland i West Falkland.

australia.title: Australia
australia.description: Australia — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin i Canberra; e Great Barrier Reef, Uluru i e Outback.

new-zealand.title: Nueva Zelandia
new-zealand.description: Nueva Zelandia — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin i Queenstown; e Alpnan di Zùit, Fiordland i Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: British Columbia
british-columbia.description: British Columbia — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George i Whistler; e Coast Mountains, Isla Vancouver i e Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Prairienan di Canada
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan i Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina i Banff; e Rocky Mountains, e prairienan i Churchill na Hudson Bay.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston i Thunder Bay; Niagara Falls, e Lagonan Grandi i Algonquin Park.

quebec.title: Quebec
quebec.description: Quebec — Montréal, Siudat di Quebec, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke i Saguenay; e St. Lawrence, e Laurentides i e Peninsula di Gaspé.

atlantic-canada.title: Canada Atlántiko
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, i Newfoundland i Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton i Charlottetown; e Cabot Trail i Bay of Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Nort di Canada
northern-canada.description: Yukon, Northwest Territories i Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City i Inuvik; e Arkipielago Ártiko i riu Mackenzie.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong i Macau
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong i Macau — Isla di Hong Kong, Kowloon, New Territories, Lantau i e Peninsula di Macau, Taipa i Coloane.

antarctica.title: Antártika
antarctica.description: Antártika — Estashon McMurdo, Base Scott i Villa Las Estrellas; e Península Antártiko, e Islanan Shetland di Zùit, e plataforma di glas di Ross i Seru Erebus. E mapa ta kaba na 85° zùit i no ta yega Polo Zùit.
